name: smwmusic-touhou-koumakyou-the-embodiment-of-the-scarlet-devil-devil-s-2nd-hand-luna-dial-lunar-clock-remix
title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Devil's 2nd Hand 🕒 ~ Luna Dial ~ Lunar Clock (Remix)
description:
ZA WARUDO!!

Did an arrangement of Dio Brando's Sakuya Izayoi's theme, Luna Dial ~ Lunar Clock from Touhou 6: Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil. Essentially the "Shadow the Hedgehog" of the series in terms of her insane popularity from her multiple appearances in the series (including the latest mainline entry as of this upload, Touhou 18). She was one of my favorites when I got into the series and I still hold her up pretty high.

Always been a fan of her EoSD themes, especially her boss theme (aka this song). It's dark and tense, which is fitting for Sakuya's fight in that game.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor w/ Slight Detune (Original Pitch - Listening Only)
2. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
3. C# Minor (MIDI Pitch)
4. B Minor (Custom Pitch)
